enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take out bowl and pan from cabinet. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Select clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to door. Pick up keys. Open door. Walk out. Close door.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Show ID. Walk to locker room. Change into work uniform. Walk to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Administer medication. Update patient records. Assist with mobility. Communicate with doctor. Attend meeting. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Wash hands. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Open door. Walk in. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Close dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Open hamper. Pick up clothes. Walk to washing machine. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Close washing machine. Open detergent drawer. Add detergent. Close drawer. Press start button. Wait. Check cycle. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Walk to dryer. Open dryer. Load clothes. Close dryer. Press start button.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for login. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Open phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Browse internet. Open document. Type report. Save file. Close laptop. Stand up.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Adjust pillow.
Lie in bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
